action.name: Longsword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) slashing damage plus 4 ({@damage 1d8}) radiant damage. On a roll of 19 or 20, Jared scores a critical hit.

reaction.name: Protect Ally
entries: When a creature Jared can see attacks a target other than Jared that is within 5 feet of him, Jared imposes disadvantage on the attack roll.
